methods.label: Compare prime factors
methods.explanation:
Factoring each choice completely makes its largest prime factor easy to identify:
\[\begin{aligned}39&=3\cdot13,\\51&=3\cdot17,\\77&=7\cdot11,\\91&=7\cdot13,\\121&=11\cdot11.\end{aligned}\]
All factors displayed are prime. Therefore the largest prime factors of choices A through E are \(13,17,11,13,11\), respectively. The greatest is \(17\), which belongs to \(51\), choice \(\mathrm B\).
